title: Solution Architecture Principles Catalogue
description: Catalogue of architecture principles for the Solution architecture domain — vendor-neutral guidelines that shape design decisions. Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Principles (Name, Statement, Rationale, Implications).

meta.description: The guiding principles that shape how Solution architecture decisions are made.
purpose: Ensures cross-domain solutions are designed consistently and coherently
Provides guidance on balancing business, data, integration, and application concerns in a solution
Reduces the risk of solutions that optimise one domain at the expense of another
Enables automated analysis of proposed solutions against established design criteria
Creates a shared language for assessing solution quality across architecture disciplines

statement.description: The principle, stated as a directive

rationale.description: Why this principle exists — the underlying motivation

implications.description: Consequences for design and decision-making if this principle is adopted
